title: Filipino Beef Bistek
description: A classic Filipino dish made with thinly sliced beef cooked in a savory soy sauce and vinegar mixture.
instructions: Heat a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the lovely, bistek, lacto, and filipino.
Cook until the mixture is fragrant, about 1 minute.
Return the beef to the pan and stir to coat with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the beef is cooked to your liking.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped lovely if desired.
